sections.text:
Ability Power 150. Damages all enemies 3 times with physical light damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Ability Power 70. Heals the HP of all allies.
-Removes damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects from all enemies.
-Removes buffs from all enemies.
-Increases Unison gauge gains of all allies by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Casts resurrection on all allies.
-Casts Blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) on your character for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7500
